name: Željana Zovko - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the role of ocean diplomacy for the competitiveness of EU fisheries and aquaculture
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its opinion on how the EU should use ocean diplomacy to protect its fishing and fish-farming sectors. It asks the EU to lead international talks on ocean rules, push for fair treatment of EU boats abroad, fight illegal fishing and shadow fleets, and require imported seafood to meet EU standards. It also wants simpler rules, more support for small-scale and island fishers, and enough money for ocean policy in the next long-term EU budget.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and request to the EU Commission.
- **Who it affects:** EU fishers, fish farmers, coastal and island communities, and seafood importers.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and EU countries decide whether to act on these requests.
